4896353.short: Rolder (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.

4905664.name: A.J. Haulcy
4905664.short: Haulcy (ankle) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Cowboys, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

4912218.name: Cyrus Allen
4912218.short: Allen caught two of three targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.

4912274.name: Sione Vaki
4912274.short: Vaki (ankle) is available for Sunday's game against Miami.

4912847.name: Jacob Parrish
4912847.short: Parrish registered seven total tackles (four solo) and two passes defensed, including an interception, during Sunday's 16-0 win over Atlanta.

4917427.name: Tanner Koziol
4917427.short: Koziol finished Thursday's 33-10 win over Baltimore with two catches for 15 yards on two targets.

4950400.name: Arvell Reese
4950400.short: Reese posted seven tackles (five solo), including 0.5 sacks, in Sunday's 27-21 overtime victory against the Texans.

5081335.name: Drew Stevens
5081335.short: Stevens made four of his five field-goal attempts and converted his only extra-point try during Sunday's 27-10 win versus the Eagles.

5081394.name: James Pearce Jr.
5081394.short: Pearce (back) is listed as active Sunday versus the Bengals in Madrid, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

5081432.name: Antonio Williams
5081432.short: Williams caught five of seven targets for 54 yards during Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

5082269.name: Dean Connors
5082269.short: Connors (hand) was placed on IR on Tuesday, Blaine Grisak of SI.com reports.

5083076.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
5083076.short: Fannin (groin) will play Sunday against the Saints, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

5083315.name: Kenyon Sadiq
5083315.short: Sadiq caught one of two targets for 22 yards in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

5083754.name: Ryan Flournoy
5083754.short: With George Pickens (hamstring) inactive, Flournoy is slated to move into the No. 2 WR role opposite CeeDee Lamb in Sunday's game against the Colts, while Jonathan Mingo will be the team's No. 3 receiver, Todd Archer of ESPN reports.

5084939.name: Isaiah Adams
5084939.short: The Cardinals activated Adams (ankle) off injured reserve Saturday, and he remains questionable for Sunday's matchup against the Seahawks.

5088571.name: Bryce Boettcher
5088571.short: Boettcher (groin) was a full participant at the Colts' practice Wednesday.

5092508.name: Colbie Young
5092508.short: Young went without a target while playing 19 of the Bengals' 74 snaps on offense in Sunday's 43-36 overtime win over the Titans.

5150247.name: Malik Benson
5150247.short: Benson (coach's decision) is a healthy scratch for Sunday's battle against San Francisco.

5150660.name: Anterio Thompson
5150660.short: Thompson posted on social media this week that he was diagnosed with a genetic mutation on his spinal cord in early May and indicated that he was told he will "never play football again," Josh Kendall of The Athletic reports.

5151317.name: Robert Henry Jr.
5151317.short: The Commanders claimed Henry off waivers from the Seahawks on Tuesday.

5208518.name: Charlie Smyth
5208518.short: The Saints elevated Smyth from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday.

5216101.name: Dondrea Tillman
5216101.short: Tillman is active for Sunday's game against the Panthers, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.

5220680.name: Ted Hurst III
5220680.short: Hurst failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

8439.name: Aaron Rodgers
8439.short: Rodgers completed 13 of 25 passes for 172 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.
